spanish: Y pusieron sobre él príncipes de tributos, a fin de afligirlo en sus cargas; y edificó ciudades de depósitos a Faraón, a Pitom y a Raamses.

findings.issue: Spanish lists a Faraón, a Pitom y a Raamses with the same a, so Pitom and Raamses read as parallel לְ-beneficiaries with Pharaoh; Hebrew has לְ only on Pharaoh and marks Pitom/Raamses with את as the cities built (apposition to ערי מסכנות), not recipients.
findings.spanishSpan: a Faraón, a Pitom y a Raamses

notes: Subject number and the affliction/burden clause otherwise match the tokens.
